name: Hindprakash Industries Limited
summary: Hindprakash Industries Limited manufactures and trades in dyes, auxiliaries, intermediates, and chemicals in India and internationally. The company offers acid, cationic basic, disperse, direct, and reactive dyes. It also provides chemical and auxiliaries, such as pretreatment chemicals, dyeing auxiliaries, green acid, printing auxiliaries, finishing auxiliaries, and washing of agents, as well as basic chemicals and solvents. In addition, the company provides pigments, resins, adhesive, and food colors. It serves dyestuff and dye intermediates, textiles, construction chemicals, and specialty chemicals sectors. The company was founded in 1942 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
